title: 4 Continents | Dreamfarmcommons
plain_text:
​
Saturday, November 16, 2019 at 10 AM – 1 PM4 Continents: A Virtual Reality Moment and Meal
4 artists in 4 countries from 4 different continents have been working for several months building a virtual environment to be experienced with audience, creating a collaborative artwork and synchronicity of actions. Come to Dream Farm to enter that virtual world and eat breakfast here in Oakland. A similar event will be happening in Nigeria, Argentina, and France.
4 continents VR is a project that seeks to explore new heights in the realm of collaborative technology.
Contact us on sixervr@gmail.com to RSVP or learn more about this project.
